content.thinking:
I'm weighing whether to ask the customer for documents or send the case back as incomplete when an ID check result is still unknown. One option is to leave the rules as they are, so the unknown case keeps requesting documents, and the other is to drop the unknown branch from the rule.

I'm settling on the fix: drop the unknown branch so the rule only fires on an explicit "no". An unknown value then makes the rule possibly applicable, which leads to an incomplete outcome rather than the rule quietly stopping. I'm framing the question for the owner as whether an unfinished identity check should trigger a document request or send the case back as incomplete.

parsed.question: When an identified individual's identity check hasn't been done or hasn't come back yet, so it is neither verified nor failed, should 3.4 ask the customer for documents, or should the case go back as incomplete under 2.2?

options.option: Ask the customer for documents now
options.says: 3.4 asks the customer for documents whenever any identified individual's identity is not confirmed as verified, including while the check hasn't been done or hasn't come back.

options.option: Mark incomplete until the check comes back
options.says: 3.4 asks for documents only when an identity check failed; while a check hasn't been done or hasn't come back, the case is incomplete under 2.2 and goes back for more investigation.

rule.text: Verify the identity of every identified individual. If any is unverified, request documents.
